title: Ngeli ya U-ZI (Theme 5: Kukabiliana na umaskini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of U-ZI take u- in the singular and zi- in the plural, and that the plural noun drops u- (ufunguo -> funguo).
representations: real keys and walls in pictures
contexts: facing poverty (kukabiliana na umaskini): building walls

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Ufunguo umepotea" and "Funguo zimepotea".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wingi wa "ukuta" ni ___." Kwa nini "mikuta" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika ngeli ya U-ZI, tunaondoa u- au kubadili herufi za mwanzo: ukuta - kuta, wimbo - nyimbo, ubao - mbao.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kuta mbili ___meanguka." Kwa nini "i" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa nomino za U-ZI hupatana na zi-: kuta zimeanguka. Mi- ni ya ngeli nyingine, kama miti.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ukuta ___meanguka." Kwa nini "i" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Umoja wa ngeli ya U-ZI hupatana na u-: ukuta umeanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Ni nini kinatoka katika wingi wa nomino hii?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa ukuta ni kuta: u- inaondoka.
